# TOUCAN-CLASS ROBOTICS SHUTTLE
[color=#a4885c]Ship Size:[/color] Medium
[color=#a4885c]Recommended Crew:[/color] 2-4
[color=#a4885c]Power Gen Type:[/color] Uranium x2
# Shuttle Brief
The Toucan is a premium-class medical shuttle with a split focus between organic and synthetic care. Fully-equipped robotics and chem labs together with a spaceous triage area facilitate efficient rescue and treatment operations. The ship features a full suite of amenities, which allow the crew to operate for extended periods of time without returning to port.
# Technical Details
In standard configuration, the Toucan has a power load of 41.9 kW. Disengaging navigational systems via the button located in engineering (and doubled in the bridge) brings this number down to 13.5 kW.
The ship is devided into three sections for the purposes of APC distribution: Port (powers Engineering, port side of the entrance corridor and Breakroom), Starboard (powers Restroom, Bedroom, starboard side of the entrance corridor and Bridge), and Bow (powers Robotics Lab, Chem Lab and Triage).
The shuttle features a robust disposals network that allows quick transfer of salvage and litter to the material reclaimer, and just as quick transfer of reclaimed materials to the robotics lab.
The Toucan is equipped with 17 thrusters: 7 rear-facing, 4 forward-facing and 6 side-facing (3 for each side).
